history.content: how does indox merge vector and bm25 results
It uses Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Each retriever returns a ranked list; RRF scores items by 1/(k + rank) summed across lists, with k=60 by convention. Items high in both lists win.

history.content: explain how the vector relevance floor works
